convert_caffe2_name_to_pytorch: get the name conversion function and convert a Caffe2 layer name to PyTorch format
convert_nonlocal_layer_names: use get_name_convert_func to convert nonlocal convolution layer names from Caffe2 to PyTorch
convert_resnet_layer_names: use get_name_convert_func to convert ResNet branch layer names from Caffe2 to PyTorch
convert_batch_norm_names: use get_name_convert_func to convert batch normalization parameter names from Caffe2 to PyTorch
convert_head_layer_names: use get_name_convert_func to convert prediction head layer names from Caffe2 to PyTorch
